authority.domain: ATmega328P architecture facts, direct-port fast paths, scheduler modular-time invariants and registration-order assumptions

scheduler.required_period_relation: every scheduled period and first delay must be < 32768 ms
scheduler.invariant: task IDs 0..5 must remain the six blue-LED tasks because setBlinkIntervalIndex() updates them arithmetically without a task-ID table

blue_leds.invariant: pins must remain contiguous D2..D7 and map one-to-one to PORTD bits 2..7

buttons.operation: single PINC read shared by three buttons
buttons.invariant: main/decrease/increase buttons must remain A0/A1/A2 in that order for the current fast path

scheduler_heartbeat.invariant: heartbeat pin must remain A3/PC3 for the current fast path

consequences: D12 remains available as the orange display-activity GPIO.
D13 remains TFT SCK and is also connected to the Uno built-in L LED.

validation_rules: The largest derived blink interval must remain below the scheduler signed-comparison half range.
All fixed scheduler periods and first delays must remain below 32768 ms.
Changing any fast-path pin assignment requires changing or disabling the corresponding AVR direct-port implementation.
